value: the election voting day has been moved to 30 May 2024
detail: Voting day was 29 May 2024; polls open 07h00-21h00. There is no 30 May voting.

value: registered voters can now cast their ballot at any voting station nationwide
detail: Voters must vote at the station where they are registered; voting elsewhere required a section 24A notification submitted by 17 May 2024.

value: voters can use a driver's licence or passport to vote
detail: Only a SA smart ID card, green barcoded ID book, or temporary ID certificate is accepted. A passport, driving licence or student card is NOT accepted.

value: Heads up 👀 word is the IEC pushed voting day to 30 May this year. Don't pitch up on the 29th for nothing! Spread the word. #SAElections2024

Sipho Maluleke, a member of parliament
detail: announced that the election has been postponed to June
source/maps_to: The election was held on 29 May 2024 and was not postponed.

value: Nomsa Khwela, a member of parliament
detail: told supporters they can vote twice if they are registered in two provinces
source/maps_to: Each voter may vote once, at their registered voting station. Double voting is an offence.

value: Pieter van Niekerk, a member of parliament
detail: claimed voters without an ID can still vote using a sworn affidavit
source/maps_to: A valid SA ID card, green ID book, or temporary ID certificate is required; an affidavit is not a substitute.

value: Lerato Dube, a member of parliament
detail: said voters can cast their ballots online or by SMS this election instead of going to a voting station
source/maps_to: Voters may APPLY for a special vote online or by SMS (ID to 32249), but every ballot is CAST in person - at a voting station or via an IEC home visit (special voting 27-28 May 2024). There is no online or SMS casting of votes.

value: Ahmed Patel, a member of parliament
detail: urged residents to vote at any station because district rules were scrapped
source/maps_to: District rules apply; voters must vote where registered unless a s24A notice was filed by 17 May 2024.
